authors: Doan Thi An, Tjoon Tow Teng, James Malcolm Sangster
title: Vapour pressures of CaCl2-NaCl-H2O and MgCl2-NaCl-H2O at 25 C. Prediction of the water activity of supersaturated NaCl solutions
needs_pass2_reason: scanned page with OCR-quality text layer; all 59 cells were read from the 220 dpi image (text layer unusable for tables); one misprint-like glyph ('2:3501') resolved from the image
experimental_method: Static vapour-pressure method at 25 C; salts weighed into the flask, water distilled in under vacuum, solution concentrated stepwise by evaporating solvent; water activity from vapour pressure.
quality_remarks: No correction for vapour-phase non-ideality (stated). NaCl-only osmotic coefficients checked against Gibbard et al. in Fig. 1 (deviations of a few 1e-3 to 3e-3 in phi, graph only). Concentrations extend beyond NaCl saturation (supersaturated mixed solutions are not supersaturated in the strict sense because of the second salt).

extraction_notes: Columns: m1 = first salt (MgCl2 in Table 1, CaCl2 in Table 2), m2 = NaCl, a_w, phi. Authors state phi is given to the fourth decimal only for rounding (Table 1 footnote).
